title: Declared dependencies and runtime configuration
description: Inspect the actual manifests requirements.txt. Separate declared packages/settings from imports, installed state, secrets, and runtime success. The test/configuration evidence is traced into implementation src/main.py.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in requirements.txt.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
